section_summary.extract_value: This section presents an exploratory theoretical model describing hypothesized relationships among caregiver eating messages, attachment styles, perfectionism, body appreciation, and depressive symptoms in college women. The text outlines the theoretical rationale for each path in the model, citing previous research to justify predicted associations (e.g., restrictive/critical eating messages negatively predicting body appreciation, attachment anxiety inversely predicting body appreciation). The section concludes by noting that while bivariate associations have been explored in prior research, the unique contribution of each path in the integrated model is unknown, and the model will be tested with provisions to trim non-significant paths and add unanticipated paths that substantially improve model fit.
